findings.description: This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption setting can be stored unencrypted at rest.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL does not encrypt stored ledger export data.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not protect artifact contents from being stored unencrypted.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Runbook objects may be stored unencrypted unless every uploader independently requests encryption.

The uploaded vendor roster object does not specify server-side encryption, and its target bucket has no default encryption configuration. The object may therefore be stored without encryption at rest.
